messages:
anna_docs: Heads-up — I'm drafting the release blurb for next week's docs push. Need a compact 'what's new' + short known-issues blurb. Can folks sanity-check?
liam_prod: pinging to confirm the runtime fallback rename — is it `fallback_policy` -> `route_policy` now? That affects the API example.
sam_devex: yes, we renamed it in the API layer. Example should be `route_policy: 'latency'` instead of `fallback_policy`. I'll update SDK snippet if you want.
tasha_pm: also call out the quantization profile v2 caveat — customers on older Dedicated stacks may see slight output variance. Keep it brief, link to migration guide.
anna_docs: ack. Draft below — please edit inline: 

What's new
• route_policy routing option for smarter fallbacks (SDK examples updated)
• quantization profile v2 for lower cost on A100/RTX (see migration note)
• streaming improvements: better buffer flush for short-lived connections

Known issues
• Streaming may truncate after ~512 tokens on some 3rd-party kernels — workaround: set `stream_chunk_size: 128` or use the hosted runtime. PR for kernel patch is queued.

Code snippet (JS SDK):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood();
const r = await client.text.generate({
  model: 'open-kestrel-1',
  route_policy: 'latency',
  prompt: 'Summarize the release notes',
  stream_chunk_size: 128,
});
```

liam_prod: draft looks good. Quick ask: can we add a one-line compatibility note for private deployments (KMS integration)?
izzy_reviewer: small nit — the JS example still uses `text.generate`. We standardized on `client.generateText()` in the new SDK. Sam, can you confirm?
sam_devex: oh right, our migration landed. New method is `client.generateText()` — I'll push updated snippets in the SDK samples PR.
anna_docs: I'll swap the snippet. Also adding this link to migration guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/wiki/quant-v2-migration (internal)
tasha_pm: for product copy: can we say "small output variance" instead of "slight output variance" — legal likes consistent wording.
anna_docs: done.
liam_prod: PRs: docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4382 (draft relnotes + snippets). SDK sample update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1293
izzy_reviewer: flagged one more thing in the draft — the embed size change note needs explicit cost impact stat, e.g., "embedding units cost +12% for 1536->1792 dims" — do we have an exact number?
sam_devex: finance gave an estimate: ~11–13% per-embedding token on our hosted tiers. I'll add "~12%" and mark as estimate.
anna_docs: put as "~12% increase on hosted pricing; Dedicated may vary"
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: docs staging site update at 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z (CI #7854) :white_check_mark:
liam_prod: can we get a one-line callout in the relnotes about link fixes? There were a bunch of stale internal-to-public URL redirects that needed updates.
anna_docs: adding: "Several SDK and streaming docs links fixed — redirect notices removed."
izzy_reviewer: LGTM besides the small wording nits I left as comments in the PR.
tasha_pm: thanks everyone — target to merge today so marketing can review tomorrow. :rocket:
anna_docs: I'll squash/merge after SDK snippet PR lands. Leaving this thread open for any late blockers.
